title: Haystack-DS+ISW Security for Larger Plaintext Blocks
summary: Existing cryptanalysis treats one-bit encoded plaintext blocks; determining how Haystack-DS+ISW security changes for larger blocks remains open.

formal_statement.body: For Haystack-DS+ISW, existing cryptanalysis sets the encoded plaintext-block size to $n=1$ for simplicity. Determine how the security of Haystack-DS+ISW changes when $n$ is increased beyond $1$.

scope.domain: Cryptanalysis of the Haystack-DS+ISW symmetric-encryption construction.
parameters: n: encoded plaintext-block size, fixed at 1 in existing cryptanalysis and varied beyond 1 in the open question
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine the effect of increasing the encoded plaintext-block size beyond one on the security of Haystack-DS+ISW.

citations.label: Haystack ciphers : White-box countermeasures as Symmetric encryption

progress.summary: The appendix fixes the encoded plaintext-block size at one for simplicity and highlights the security effect of increasing it as a direction of interest.
citation_labels: Alex Charlès et al., Haystack ciphers : White-box countermeasures as Symmetric encryption
